Lens Replacement in Your Frame

New lenses in your own frame

If you already love your frame, there's no need to buy a new one. Bring it in — even if it came from another store or online — and we'll fit new prescription lenses.

Call (714) 530-6700 Directions

What we offer

  • New prescription lenses in frames bought anywhere
  • Upgrade to progressives, blue light filtering or light-adaptive lenses
  • Turn a favorite frame into prescription sunglasses
  • Lenses cut and fitted in our in-store lab
  • Frame inspection before we start

Good to know

Every frame is inspected first. Older frames, especially rimless and thin metal ones, can be weakened by age, and there is a small risk that they break during lens fitting. We'll point out any concerns before you decide.

Turnaroundabout 3 business days for most orders

Lens Replacement in Your Frame: common questions

Can you replace lenses in frames I bought online?

Usually yes, as long as the frame is in good condition and suits your prescription.

How long does lens replacement take?

Most jobs are ready in about 3 business days. You may need to leave the frame with us while the lenses are made, so bring a backup pair if you have one.

Will my insurance cover lenses only?

Most vision plans cover lenses separately from frames, so yes in most cases.
